title: Northstar desk briefing — daily on-call synthesis
content:
Northstar desk briefing — 2029-07-21
Shift owner: Evelyn Park (06:00-14:00 PDT)
Pocket notes for next rotation: Marco R.

Summary (high level):
- Two operational issues during the shift: a transient EU region latency spike (major customer impact windows) and an elevated error rate from the tokenization service after a canary. Both mitigated; follow-ups created.
- No data exfiltration or billing anomalies observed. No SLA breaches declared, but customer-facing ticket opened for degraded perf.

Incident A — EU region latency spike (start 2029-07-21 04:12 UTC):
- Symptom: sudden rise in p50/p95/p99 for hosted-inference routes in eu-west-1; request queue depth increased; tail latency > 3s for ~18 minutes.
- Detection: alert EU-INFERENCE-LATENCY firing at 04:13 UTC. Pager to SRE rotation.
- Immediate mitigation: scaled dedicated pool for eu-west-1 by +40% (manual scale via console), enabled fallback routing to reserve pool in us-west-2 for critical routes.
- Root cause (current hypothesis): autoscaler stopped responding to the request-rate metric due to a mis-evaluated Prometheus recording rule (rate() window mismatch after recent rules refactor). Autoscaler interpreted stale metrics as low load and failed to provision in time.
- Evidence: prometheus rule eval logs (see linked confluence), autoscaler controller logs show last successful scrape timestamp mismatch.
- Impact: ~15% of requests were routed to fallback; SLO risk window ~18m. No permanent degradation.
- Action items created: SRE-3421 (alert tuning + fix rule), SRE-3422 (postmortem draft).

Incident B — tokenization-service elevated 5xx (start 2029-07-21 07:40 UTC):
- Symptom: client-facing 502/504 increases localized to tokenization-worker pool. Canary release (runtime PR #2987) rolled 07:34 UTC.
- Mitigation: immediate rollback of canary to previous image at 07:46 UTC; traffic normalized by 07:55 UTC.
- Root cause: new backpressure handling path introduced in PR made the worker block on rare NPE path when backlog > threshold.
- Follow-up: devs will add unit test for backlog path and add circuit-breaker, see PR follow-up GH-2990. Ticket: SRE-3423.

Timeline (short):
- 04:12 UTC: EU latency alert -> triage.
- 04:18 UTC: manual scale + fallback routing enabled.
- 04:30 UTC: latency trending down; alert closed after 04:30-04:35.
- 07:34 UTC: canary rollout begins.
- 07:40 UTC: tokenization 5xx spike detected -> rollback 07:46 UTC.
- 07:55 UTC: error rates return to baseline.

Commands run / quick ops notes: (copy for next shift)
- Manual scale pool: rcli compute scale --pool eu-west-1-inference --count +40
- Enable fallback routing (temp): rcli routing set-policy --region eu-west-1 --fallback us-west-2 --priority emergency
- Check queue depths: prometheus query: sum(kafka_queue_depth{topic="inference-requests",region="eu-west-1"})
- Autoscaler logs: kubectl -n infra logs deploy/autoscaler-controller --since=2h | grep evaluation

Runbook drafts / updates needed (short list):
1) autoscaler-metrics-failure-runbook (DRAFT) — new file to add under /runbooks/autoscaler/
   - Symptoms: EU-INFERENCE-LATENCY alert + stale prometheus timestamps.
   - Triage steps: check prometheus rules, check alertmanager silence, check scrape targets, check controller health.
   - Mitigation: manual scale instruction + fallback enable.
   - Postmortem steps: preserve metrics, annotate alert with firing window.
   -> Assigned: Priya Shah. Deadline: 2029-07-25. Ticket: SRE-3421.

2) tokenization-canary-rollback-guidance (DRAFT)
   - Add explicit canary health checks for backlog and NPE traces.
   - Add shorter canary window for tokenization (5m) + automated rollback on 2xx drop.
   -> Assigned: Liam O'Connor, will submit PR to infra/canaries by 2029-07-24. Ticket: SRE-3423.

Post-incident items (follow-ups and owners):
- SRE-3421: Fix Prometheus recording rule + add unit test for eval window (owner: Priya).
- SRE-3422: Full incident writeup + timeline (owner: Evelyn). Draft due 2029-07-23.
- SRE-3423: Tokenization canary hardening + regression tests (owner: Liam).
- Add automated synthetic to run prediction route in eu-west-1 every 2m to catch tail latency earlier (owner: Marco).

Customer/External comms:
- Opened customer ticket TKT-6681 for affected EU customers, referencing degraded performance during window 04:12-04:30 UTC. No credit or SLA action at this time; will escalate if postmortem deems required. Assigned to CS escalation: Noor Patel.

Monitoring / Alerts tweaks proposed immediately:
- Change EU-INFERENCE-LATENCY alert to use a 3m rolling window for p95 with token-count normalization.
- Add autoscaler-controller heartbeat alert if last_successful_scrape > 3m.
- Add explicit canary health check metric for tokenization backlog.

Notes to next shift (priority watchlist):
- Watch autoscaler-controller heartbeat in prometheus. If heartbeat gap appears >2m, escalate to infra lead.
- Keep an eye on queue depth metric: kafka_queue_depth{topic="inference-requests",region="eu-west-1"} > 2000 -> pre-scale.
- Verify synthetic predictions in eu-west-1 are within p95 baseline: run script: ./tools/synthetics/run_single.sh --region eu-west-1 --route predict

Loose / personal notes (to self):
- Remember to capture the autoscaler controller PID logs before they rotate (PRM retention is 48h).
- Drafting timeline will require preserved metric snapshots at 04:00-05:00 UTC — export them before 2029-07-22 23:59 UTC.

Attachments / useful links: (copy to ticket)
- Incident charts: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/EU/latency-dashboard?from=2029-07-21T04:00:00Z&to=2029-07-21T05:00:00Z
- Prom rule eval history: https://prometheus.redwood.com/rules?group=autoscaler
- Canary PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2987
- Postmortem template: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/SRE/Postmortem+Template

Sign-off: Evelyn Park

End of brief.
